checks: Version and current point visible; total progress uses completed points, target has no misleading percentage
Current-point inlier sample fluctuations cannot erase global checkpoints or rewind total bar
Blink debounce and actionable persistent blocker kept; saved points unchanged
Real unfinished-point restart explained; old restart message not carried onto new point
Legitimate backwards validation retry re-acknowledges target, labels retry and retains all saved checkpoints

fit_retry stays unblocked initially and after700ms; selective training retry is labelled as setup, retains 12 saved checkpoints and 99% pending status; a repeated attempt on the same point receives a fresh target acknowledgement without restarting the session
Older same-ID revision cannot move target or saved count backwards
Low capture cadence is explained without claiming faster analysis; saved checkpoints stay visible, and allowed cadence/window/frame-age/analysis-ms metrics enter diagnostics
Calm low-cadence explanation stays on the same point instead of flashing when rates cross the threshold
Unknown, one-frame and zero cadence do not create fake rates or division results; backend expanded sample window independently explains slow collection
Bounded 90-snapshot diagnostic export is available on failure, excludes names/PIN/tokens/IDs/images/paths and raw errors
GET state begun before calibration cannot falsely cancel new wizard when its old reply or failure arrives after POST; cancelled run keeps diagnostic on preparation screen
A genuinely replaced server calibration still stops visibly; stale-response guard does not hide real replacement

Fit failure after all12 captures explains measurement accuracy without blaming gaze/head; only available measured and allowed percentages are shown, and quality diagnostics omit all unknown nested information
Combined uncertainty12% versus allowed10% explains rejection when RMS4% and held-out error8% separately pass; absent uncertainty is neither calculated nor fabricated in the UI
Four-decimal percent precision keeps slightly excessive .07501/.14001 errors visibly distinct from .075/.14 limits; RMS label matches the actual metric
All explicit quality-failure codes are recognized; partial metrics never invent limits or validation results, invalid scalar/list values are excluded from display and diagnostics

Insufficient-range failure explains that mapping and accuracy metrics are unavailable, hides tables containing only limits, preserves limits in diagnostics and treats a genuine zero error as a measured result

Noise failure distinguishes unstable measurements from user performance; jitter8% and combined uncertainty12% versus10% are displayed, aggregate iris ranges/noise remain original diagnostic ratios rather than screen percentages, and absent jitter never becomes zero

CSSOM proves central coach starts 60 CSS pixels below the actual target with bounded bottom and scroll overflow, no short-screen rule overrides its top; geometry checked at1366×768,1280×720,1067×600,911×512 (no pixel rendering)
limitations: JavaScript/DOM integration with controlled camera, HTTP ordering, clock and native bridge; no physical camera or Windows rendering test.
